The decoder retains the terminal-carry value, source positivity, leading-digit and zero-width guards. The original Agent #11 `/root/review134_resume` run rebuilt all 15 modules and the origin audit from an empty project-object directory with official Lean4.19.0, release commit `6caaee842e94`, and `--trust=0 -j1 -DElab.async=false`. The original source/runtime snapshots, manifests, driver, complete command logs and independent-review receipt are retained with attribution.

The 22 unsafe implementation axioms and 874 unsafe implementation definitions remain separately inventoried; none of those unsafe-axiom names occurs in an audited theorem/safe-definition axiom map. This is not an assertion that the implementation inventory is empty or that compiler/runtime correctness was formally proved.

### Documentary correction and current integration obligation

This is exact-source approval. Agent12 retains PR113 delivery, Agent18 retains PR134, and Agent31 remains the acknowledged main writer.
